subject: JaxBARF kickoff — pose refinement without SfM
body: Team — kickoff for JaxBARF in the vision portfolio. From our release: a JAX implementation of BARF — bundle-adjusting neural radiance fields — built on JaxNeRF, modified for trainable camera poses and the BARF-style MLP changes. Why vision cares: our capture partners deliver imagery with noisy or missing camera poses, and BARF's joint pose-refinement-plus-NeRF training is the cleanest path to reconstruction without a separate SfM stage. The release already reports rotation-error parity with the PyTorch BARF implementation across the Blender scenes, so the repro bar is concrete. Milestones: Blender-scene training repro (the install.sh/train.sh path) with pose-error parity by March 27; a noisy-pose robustness study on partner-style captures through April; handoff recommendation by mid-May (window closes May 18). Bruno owns staffing and the data-platform coordination. — Lucia
